data.long_meaning: From the Old English words 'nora' meaning advice and 'land' meaning ruler or land. The name Noland is a derivative of Norse names and is often associated with Scandinavian heritage. Historically, Nolands have been known for their strong leadership qualities and wise counsel. The name Noland carries the meaning “Advisor, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Noland usually hope their child will grow to embody advisor, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
